key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Show a status icon in the top bar alongside the system indicators.

key.name: indicator-connected
key.description: Show the status indicator when WARP is connected.

key.name: indicator-connecting
key.description: Show the status indicator when WARP is connecting.

key.name: indicator-disconnected
key.description: Show the status indicator when WARP is disconnected.

key.name: indicator-disabled
key.description: Show the status indicator when the WARP service is not running.

key.name: indicator-no-route
key.description: Show the status indicator when there is no route to host.

key.name: indicator-offline
key.description: Show the status indicator when the system is offline.

key.name: indicator-error
key.description: Show the status indicator when an unknown error occurs.

key.name: indicator-not-registered
key.description: Show the status indicator when WARP is not registered.

key.name: show-account-details
key.description: Fetch and display the registered account or organisation name in the toggle subtitle.

key.name: use-custom-warp-cli
key.description: Whether to use a custom path for the warp-cli executable instead of the default.

key.name: custom-warp-cli-path
key.description: The custom path to the warp-cli executable.

key.name: enable-connecting-animation
key.description: Animate the toggle icon while WARP is connecting.

key.name: poll-interval
key.description: How often (in seconds) the extension checks the WARP connection status.
